safe_claim: Under the exact fixed-stem, stem-survival, homogeneous time-varying law, geometric tip-count inversion and a conditional DKW--Massart node-age band give an at-least-nominal simultaneous confidence set for the pulled scale F. Propagating that set through the stated affine fibre yields conditional three-valued target decisions. A separate bounded CRABS benchmark retained its failed H4 utility gate.
exclusions: No claim of topology or node-age reconstruction uncertainty coverage.
No claim for lineage-, state-, trait-, clade- or diversity-dependent processes.
No fossil preservation, observation or taxonomic-scale inference.
No coverage for derivatives of F or lambda_p obtained by differentiating the band.
No essential-complement, must-have, replacement, superiority or community-acceptance claim about CRABS.
No attribution of the historical 0.2.1 DOI to this successor.
